values./system/description:
Derived from the secretions of a Bloodbug, and the curative properties of some wasteland plants, Skeeto Spit is a wasteland remedy which dulls the user’s ability to feel pain. It’s effective, lasts a reasonable amount of time, and is non-addictive, but it normally has to be homemade as it isn’t generally produced in large quantities.
